chunks: Ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Miskān, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
I heard him say: “The limit requiring flogging in zina is that the two are found in a single cover.”

key_terms.الْجَلْدِ: flogging as a corporal legal punishment
key_terms.حَدُّ: the prescribed legal limit or punishment
key_terms.لِحَافٍ: a covering or quilt used for sleeping
key_terms.يُوجَدَا: that the two are found or discovered

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the hadd of flogging for zina when two people are found under one cover?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning zina and the circumstance in which the hadd of flogging is applied. It identifies being found together under one covering as the defining condition mentioned in the report.
